newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty firms vs basket, depos down on no revrepo.
newsitem.headline: Zloty firms vs basket, depos down on no revrepo.

text.p: The Polish zloty finished the session stronger against the basket of currencies after losing some ground on an early currency buying trend, dealers said.

They said some players bought currencies in the morning to secure positions against a possible central bank intervention, expected after the zloty firmed well above three percent from the daily trading band centre for the first time this year.
But in the afternoon the zloty mainly watched dollar/mark moves in European trade, dealers said.
"The local market was fairly sensitive to dollar/mark swings today, " said Krzysztof Mordes from BIG SA.
Money market rates fell after the central bank refrained from draining the market despite the system's overliquidity.
Overnight rates were at 20.00/20.75 percent, down from opening's 21.30/21.50 percent, tomorrow/next rates were at 20.00/20.75 percent, down from 21.35/21.60 percent.
All average yields were flat at Thursday's 400 million zloty primary tender. The treasury sold 135.6 million zlotys worth of the bills after investors bid for 281 million.
